title: Экспорт из Excel: «нет колонок: name»
notes: Excel's CSV UTF-8 starts with a byte order mark, so the first header cell reads '\ufeffname'. Both readers (load and read_header, used by --check) must skip it. Broken variants: fixing load() only (--check still fails), renaming a first cell '\ufeffname' (fails when name is not the first column and in --check).
